title: cd-collab External Run Judgment Success v1
description: Applied judgment plus an immutable run identity/provenance stub {id, caseId, sourceId, createdAt}. JSON Schema cannot compare nested applied/run identities with the envelope caseId and runId, nor look up the stored ExternalRunV1; the parser requires nested identities to match. Server/gateway must bind run.sourceId and run.createdAt exactly to that stored run.

canonicalUtcMillisecond.description: The pattern enforces canonical millisecond UTC spelling. Ajv format date-time rejects ordinary invalid calendar values such as 2024-02-30T09:20:00.000Z. The authoritative parser additionally rejects leap seconds and canonical-roundtrip anomalies such as 2016-12-31T23:59:60.000Z.

actorId.description: Opaque actor identity, not a UUID field. LDAP DN and operator-42 are valid. JSON Schema cannot express NFKC; the parser requires the value already be NFKC-normalized.

username.description: JSON Schema cannot express NFKC or trim; schema-only validation is structural. The authoritative parser normalizes with NFKC and trim.

rationale.description: JSON Schema cannot express NFKC or trim; schema-only validation is structural. The authoritative parser normalizes with NFKC and trim. Ordinary newlines are allowed.

links.description: Unique {kind,id} pairs, max 64. uniqueItems covers duplicates. Sorted canonical lexical order is parser-enforced because JSON Schema cannot compare cross-item order.

runProjection.description: Immutable identity/provenance stub. JSON Schema cannot look up the stored ExternalRunV1; the parser validates UUID/canonical time and nested id/caseId match. Server/gateway binds sourceId and createdAt exactly to that stored run.
